decisions.reason: Frozen reported doctorate institution, not a department. Official unit and degree identity reviewed separately; no individual degree claim verified.

sources.note: UCAS official 2026 history states its predecessor was the Graduate University of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, renamed UCAS in 2012. This does not prove the OM List label Chinese Academy of Sciences equals that degree-awarding predecessor in 1991 or 2008.
Current UCAS Economics and Management School has a Management Science and Engineering doctoral authorization and 2027 intake; this is a separate current institution observation.

limitations: OM List label Chinese Academy of Sciences refers to a broader research organization and reports PhD years 1991 and 2008. Neither faculty degree-awarding entity nor source-label mapping to current UCAS is verified.
Do not merge CAS with UCAS or publish UCAS doctorate under CAS ID absent identity evidence.
